const $  = (s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
let lang = 'ar';

/* ───────── Language ───────── */
function applyLang(l){
  lang = l; const d = I18N[l], html = document.documentElement;
  html.lang = l; html.dir = l==='ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  document.title = d.title; $('meta[name=description]').content = d.desc;
  $$('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>{ el.textContent = d[el.dataset.i18n]; });
  $$('[data-i18n-ph]').forEach(el=>{ el.placeholder = d[el.dataset.i18nPh]; });
  $$('[data-i18n-aria]').forEach(el=>{ el.setAttribute('aria-label', d[el.dataset.i18nAria]); });
  $$('[data-i18n-alt]').forEach(el=>{ el.alt = d[el.dataset.i18nAlt]; });
  $('#langTxt').textContent = l==='ar' ? 'EN' : 'AR';
  $('#bism').hidden = !(CONFIG.showBismillah && l==='ar');
  setMusicLabel(); buildCalendar(); tick();
  $('#gcalBtn').href = gcalUrl(); $('#mapBtn').href = CONFIG.mapsUrl;
  try{ localStorage.setItem('rm_lang', l); }catch(e){}
}
function initLang(){
  let l = CONFIG.defaultLang;
  try{ const s = localStorage.getItem('rm_lang'); if(s==='ar'||s==='en') l = s; }catch(e){}
  const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('lang'); if(q==='ar'||q==='en') l = q;
  applyLang(l);
}
$('#langBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>applyLang(lang==='ar'?'en':'ar'));

/* ───────── Calendar (December 2026 starts on a Tuesday) ───────── */
function buildCalendar(){
  const d = I18N[lang], el = $('#cal'), first = 2 /* Tue (Sun=0) */, days = 31;
  const offset = (first - d.weekStart + 7) % 7;
  let h = `<h3>${d.month}</h3><div class="g">` + d.wd.map(w=>`<div class="w">${w}</div>`).join('');
  for(let i=0;i<offset;i++) h += '<div></div>';
  for(let n=1;n<=days;n++){
    h += n===18
      ? `<div class="d ev num"><svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M52 7C78 5 95 27 93 51 91 77 68 95 44 91 20 87 5 66 9 41 13 17 37 8 63 11"/></svg>${n}</div>`
      : `<div class="d num">${n}</div>`;
  }
  const wasIn = el.classList.contains('in');
  el.innerHTML = h + '</div>';
  if(wasIn) el.classList.add('in');
}

/* ───────── Countdown ───────── */
const target = new Date(CONFIG.eventISO).getTime();
const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
function tick(){
  let ms = target - Date.now();
  if(ms <= 0){
    ['D','H','M','S'].forEach(k=>$('#cd'+k).textContent='00');
    $('#cdNote').textContent = I18N[lang].cd_done; return;
  }
  const s = Math.floor(ms/1000);
  $('#cdD').textContent = Math.floor(s/86400);
  $('#cdH').textContent = pad(Math.floor(s%86400/3600));
  $('#cdM').textContent = pad(Math.floor(s%3600/60));
  $('#cdS').textContent = pad(s%60);
  $('#cdNote').textContent = I18N[lang].cd_note;
}
setInterval(tick,1000);

/* ───────── Calendar links ───────── */
function gcalUrl(){
  const d = I18N[lang];
  return 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?' + new URLSearchParams({
    action:'TEMPLATE', text:d.ics_sum, dates:'20261218T180000/20261218T190000', ctz:'Africa/Cairo',
    location:d.ics_loc, details:d.ics_desc+'\n'+CONFIG.mapsUrl
  }).toString();
}
$('#icsBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const d = I18N[lang], now = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g,'').replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/,'Z');
  const esc = s => s.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/;/g,'\\;').replace(/,/g,'\\,').replace(/\n/g,'\\n');
  const ics = ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//Rawan & Mohamed//Wedding//EN','CALSCALE:GREGORIAN','METHOD:PUBLISH','BEGIN:VEVENT',
    'UID:rawan-mohamed-20261218@wedding-invitation','DTSTAMP:'+now,'DTSTART:20261218T160000Z','DTEND:20261218T170000Z',
    'SUMMARY:'+esc(d.ics_sum),'LOCATION:'+esc(d.ics_loc),'DESCRIPTION:'+esc(d.ics_desc+'\n'+CONFIG.mapsUrl),'URL:'+CONFIG.mapsUrl,
    'END:VEVENT','END:VCALENDAR'].join('\r\n');
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([ics],{type:'text/calendar;charset=utf-8'}));
  const a = Object.assign(document.createElement('a'),{href:url,download:'Rawan-and-Mohamed-Wedding.ics'});
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500);
  const t = $('#toast'); t.textContent = d.when_ok; setTimeout(()=>{ t.textContent=''; },3500);
});

/* ───────── Music ───────── */
const SILENT = 'data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAAIhYAQACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=';
const audio = new Audio(SILENT); audio.loop = true; audio.volume = .85; audio.preload = 'auto';
let songUrl = null;
function songReady(){
  if(songUrl) return songUrl;
  const el = document.getElementById('song-data');
  if(!el || document.readyState==='loading') return null;
  try{
    const bin = atob(el.textContent.trim()), u8 = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) u8[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    songUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([u8],{type:'audio/mp4'}));
  }catch(e){ return null; }
  return songUrl;
}
function setMusicLabel(){
  const playing = !audio.paused && audio.src !== SILENT && !!songUrl && audio.src === songUrl;
  const b = $('#musicBtn'); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(playing));
  b.setAttribute('aria-label', I18N[lang][playing ? 'music_pause' : 'music_play']);
}
function startMusic(){            // must run inside the tap
  let u = songReady();
  if(u){ audio.src = u; }
  audio.play().then(()=>{ if(!u) swapWhenReady(); setMusicLabel(); }).catch(()=>setMusicLabel());
}
function swapWhenReady(){
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{ const u = songReady(); if(u){ const was=!audio.paused; audio.src=u; if(was) audio.play().then(setMusicLabel).catch(()=>{}); } },{once:true});
}
['play','pause','ended'].forEach(ev=>audio.addEventListener(ev,setMusicLabel));
$('#musicBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(audio.paused){ const u = songReady(); if(u && audio.src!==u) audio.src = u; audio.play().catch(()=>{}); } else audio.pause();
});

/* ───────── Petals ───────── */
const PETAL_TONES = [['#f7ecdf','#e2c6b4'],['#efd5c5','#d2a68f'],['#f8efd9','#e0c8a0'],['#fffaf3','#eddccf'],['#dcb7a5','#bb8a75'],['#e9cdbd','#c99a85']];
function spawnPetals(box,n){
  if(reduce || !box) return;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const p = document.createElement('span'), w = 11 + Math.random()*13, t = PETAL_TONES[i % PETAL_TONES.length];
    p.className = 'petal';
    p.style.cssText = `left:${(Math.random()*104-2).toFixed(1)}%;width:${w.toFixed(1)}px;height:${(w*.72).toFixed(1)}px;--p1:${t[0]};--p2:${t[1]};--dx:${(Math.random()*160-80).toFixed(0)}px;animation-duration:${(11+Math.random()*10).toFixed(1)}s;animation-delay:${(-Math.random()*20).toFixed(1)}s`;
    const i2 = document.createElement('i'); i2.style.animationDuration = (2.4+Math.random()*2.6).toFixed(1)+'s'; i2.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random()*3).toFixed(1)+'s';
    p.appendChild(i2); box.appendChild(p);
  }
}
const small = matchMedia('(max-width:700px)').matches;
spawnPetals($('#petals'), small ? 9 : 15);

/* ───────── Envelope ───────── */
const env = $('#env');
(function dust(){
  const box = $('#dust');
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
    const s = document.createElement('i'), z = 3 + Math.random()*5;
    s.style.cssText = `left:${Math.random()*100}%;top:${30+Math.random()*70}%;width:${z}px;height:${z}px;animation-duration:${9+Math.random()*10}s;animation-delay:${-Math.random()*14}s`;
    box.appendChild(s);
  }
})();
let opened = false;
function openEnvelope(){
  if(opened) return; opened = true;
  startMusic();
  const t = reduce ? [0,60,160,500] : [0,2350,2750,3800];
  env.classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(()=>env.classList.add('zoom'), t[1]);
  setTimeout(()=>{ env.classList.add('fade'); document.body.classList.add('revealed'); document.body.classList.add('opened'); window.scrollTo(0,0); }, t[2]);
  setTimeout(()=>{ document.body.classList.remove('locked'); env.classList.add('gone'); env.remove(); }, t[3]);
}
$('#seal').addEventListener('click',openEnvelope);

/* ───────── Scroll effects ───────── */
const io = new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }),{threshold:.18});
$$('.reveal,.rv,#cal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
const pars = $$('[data-par]');
let ticking = false;
function parallax(){
  ticking = false;
  const vh = innerHeight;
  pars.forEach(img=>{
    const r = img.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(r.bottom < 0 || r.top > vh) return;
    const p = (r.top + r.height/2 - vh/2);
    img.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${(-p*parseFloat(img.dataset.par)).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
  });
}
if(!reduce){ addEventListener('scroll',()=>{ if(!ticking){ ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(parallax); } },{passive:true}); addEventListener('resize',parallax); }

/* ───────── RSVP ───────── */
const form = $('#rsvpForm');
form.addEventListener('submit', async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const d = I18N[lang], err = $('#formErr'), name = form.name.value.trim(), att = (form.att.value||''), note = form.note.value.trim();
  err.textContent = '';
  if(!name){ err.textContent = d.err_name; form.name.focus(); return; }
  if(!att){ err.textContent = d.err_att; return; }
  if(form._honey.value) return;                                   // spam trap
  const attLabel = att==='yes' ? 'نعم، بكل سرور — Yes' : 'نعتذر عن عدم الحضور — No';
  const btn = $('#sendBtn'); btn.disabled = true; btn.firstElementChild.textContent = d.rsvp_sending;
  const mailto = `mailto:${CONFIG.rsvpEmail}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(d.mail_sub+' — '+name)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(`الاسم / Name: ${name}\nالحضور / Attendance: ${attLabel}\nالرسالة / Note: ${note||'-'}`)}`;
  try{
    const r = await fetch('https://formsubmit.co/ajax/'+CONFIG.rsvpEmail,{
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Accept:'application/json'},
      body:JSON.stringify({_subject:'RSVP — '+name,_template:'table',_captcha:'false',name,attendance:attLabel,message:note||'-',language:lang})
    });
    const j = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
    const ok = r.ok && j && (j.success===true || j.success==='true');
    if(!ok) throw new Error('not ok');
    form.hidden = true; $('#doneOk').hidden = false; $('#doneOk').scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth'});
  }catch(_){
    $('#mailBtn').href = mailto; form.hidden = true; $('#doneFail').hidden = false;
  }finally{ btn.disabled = false; btn.firstElementChild.textContent = d.rsvp_send; }
});

/* ───────── Closing monogram — sits just above the couple's heads ───────── */
const HEADS = {x:.505, y:.345};            // where the heads are inside the photo (fractions of the image)
function placeMono(){
  const ph = $('.closing .ph'), img = $('img',ph), m = $('.closing .heads');
  if(!ph || !img || !img.naturalWidth) return;
  const W = ph.clientWidth, H = ph.clientHeight, sc = Math.max(W/img.naturalWidth, H/img.naturalHeight);
  const rw = img.naturalWidth*sc, rh = img.naturalHeight*sc;
  const pos = getComputedStyle(img).objectPosition.split(' ').map(v=>parseFloat(v)/100);
  const hx = (W-rw)*pos[0] + HEADS.x*rw, hy = (H-rh)*pos[1] + HEADS.y*rh;
  m.style.left = hx+'px';
  m.style.top = Math.max(8, hy - m.offsetHeight - Math.max(14, rh*.035))+'px';
}
(function(){ const im = $('.closing .ph img'); if(im.complete) placeMono(); else im.addEventListener('load',placeMono); })();
addEventListener('resize',placeMono); document.fonts && document.fonts.ready.then(placeMono);

initLang();
</script>
